title: Fix slideshow text/photo editability and add Love Letters image picker fallback

requirements.summary: Ensure slideshow inputs remain focusable/typable by preventing ambient/animation layers from intercepting pointer/touch events over form elements.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile and desktop, the user can tap/click into each textarea (Page 8, Page 9, Page 11, and Love Letter notes) and type text without the click being swallowed by ambient/animation layers.
The Love Letter photo frame area can be focused/tapped and is not blocked by any overlay; the caret/focus ring appears when focused.
Ambient/background visual layers (e.g., floating hearts/sparkles) do not prevent interaction with any buttons or form fields.

file_operations.description: Adjust the app-level layering so ambient/visual overlays always render behind interactive content (and never capture clicks/taps), while keeping the slideshow and all form controls (Love Letters, Page 8, Page 9, Page 11) reliably interactive.

Ensure the slideshow container establishes a higher stacking context than ambient/background layers (e.g., add an explicit z-index/stacking class) so all buttons and form fields are consistently clickable/tappable.

Ensure the pre-intro full-screen animation layer cannot intercept pointer/touch events (e.g., set it to be non-interactive) during fade/transition stages so it never blocks focusing/typing once the slideshow is shown.
Harden the ambient overlay’s non-interactive behavior across browsers (retain/verify pointer-events are disabled for the full overlay subtree and that it stays behind interactive layers).

requirements.summary: Make Love Letters photo slot accept pasted images on desktop and provide a mobile-friendly image picker fallback inside each opened LoveLetterCard (client-side only).
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop: when the user focuses the photo frame and pastes an image (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V), the pasted image is displayed in the frame for that specific letter.
Mobile: when the user taps the photo frame, they have a clear way to choose an image (file picker) and the selected image is displayed in the frame for that specific letter.
The existing notes textarea per opened letter remains editable and updates live as the user types.
No backend upload is required; the selected/pasted image is handled client-side only.

file_operations.description: Add an explicit, user-initiated image picker fallback for the photo frame (e.g., a hidden file input + a visible “Choose photo” control and/or tap-to-open behavior) while keeping existing clipboard paste support; read the selected image client-side (FileReader) and display it for the specific opened letter; keep the notes textarea fully editable and updating live. Use English for any updated helper text.
